rag.text:
Test: TC-4573 — Global - Platform connection warnings - BP behavior after revoke Trello token
Priority: High | Status: In Progress | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-374 Global - Platform connection warnings
Labels: teamextplatform

Description:
# Adding projects from Jira Primary to box scope after revoking Trello
# Task structure visibility after revoking Trello token

Steps:
1. Navigate to Box Configration -> Tasks -> Scope definition tab of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-785 Global - Box Type - CRUD operations - Task structure visibility after revoke trello token
   Expected: Scope definition tab is displayed
2. Click on "add new tool" button and add trello extplatform then click save
   Data: instruction how to add Trello is [*here*|https://wiki.softwareplant.com/display/SOFTWAREPLANT/How+to+add+Trello+extPlatform]
   Expected: Trello extplatform is added to scope definition
3. In the new browser tab go to QA Trello Account > settings and revoke connection with Big Picture/Big Gantt
   Expected: Connection revoked
4. Go back to BigPicture/Big Gantt app where scope definition of a boxName is open and refresh page
   Data: boxName: TC-785 Global - Box Type - CRUD operations - Task structure visibility after revoke trello token
   Expected: Warning log is displayed with message "You may experience synchronization problems or a complete lack of access to tasks.". On the right side of message is hyperlink 'Read more' which redirects to [wiki site|https://wiki.softwareplant.com/doc/all/troubleshooting/warning-log/connected-tool-is-not-operational?product=softwareplant.bigpicture.dawid-develop2&utm_source=app]
5. Go to Administration-> Box Types click on the "Program Box" type
   Expected: Basic configurations are displayed
6. On the menu on the left side go to Tasks-> task structure
   Expected: Accordion with trello connection is blocked for editing
7. Go back to BP/BG box scope definition of boxName and expand line Automatic rules in accordion Jira Primary
   Data: boxName: TC-785 Global - Box Type - CRUD operations - Task structure visibility after revoke trello token
   Expected: Automatic reules are expanded and fields: Scope Owner, Board, Filter, Project,Task types and Narrow down are visible.
8. Select project and save changes
   Data: # Project Name : TC-2315 Global - Platform connection warnings - Adding projects from Jira host to box scope after revoke Trello
   Expected: Project has been added to scope
9. Go to Gantt module of  boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-785 Global - Box Type - CRUD operations - Task structure visibility after revoke trello toke
   Expected: All tasks from added JC primary project are visible.
